description: Export local sidecar stores (scenes, genre-tags, playback-ext, search-history, mutations, artist-watchlist) to a single schema-versioned JSON archive. artist-watchlist is ~/.spotify-mcp/artist-watchlist.json; SPOTIFY_MCP_DATA_DIR overrides that directory.

include_history.description: Include mutation history JSONL (can be large)

output_dir.description: Directory to write the archive into, confined to the output root (default ~/.spotify-mcp/exports, set SPOTIFY_MCP_EXPORT_DIR to move it)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: export_profile_state
